title: Bridging a Synchronous Library to asyncio with run_in_executor
question: You need to use a blocking synchronous library (e.g., a legacy database driver) inside an async FastAPI endpoint. Show how to use loop.run_in_executor() to avoid blocking the event loop.

title: Tracing Which Coroutine Is Blocking a Slow Async Service
question: Your FastAPI service has high latency but CPU usage is low. How do you identify which coroutine or awaitable is the bottleneck? What tools and techniques do you use?

title: Safely Cancelling a Long-Running asyncio Task
question: You need to cancel a long-running background task (e.g., streaming data fetch) when a user disconnects. How do you cancel it cleanly, handle CancelledError, and ensure resources are released?

title: Async Context Managers: __aenter__ and __aexit__
question: Implement an async context manager class using __aenter__ and __aexit__. When do you need an async context manager instead of a regular one? Show an async database connection pool example.

title: Async Generators for Streaming Data in FastAPI
question: Show how to use an async generator (async def with yield) to stream large data from a database or file in a FastAPI StreamingResponse without loading everything into memory.
